name: Chimpmare
summary:
Welcome to Chimpmare! An unforgettable experience with tons of fun but creepy horror levels! 

Chimpmare has 3 main game modes. 

A shop where you can deck out your player with loads of hats to choose from.

An amazing PvP map that makes players fight inside a volcano!

And of course, horror levels to make you jump and run!
